system.effect:
This Grip's effect: Gain Equipment Guard, targeting yourself. After the triggering attack resolves, if it failed to hit you and the attacker is adjacent, push the attacker 1 unit.

Equipment Guard (EC01)

REACTION • Roll 2+ • USES — • RESOURCE 0

Resolution: Equipment + Vigor / Resolve / Anima; automatic effect

Range / Targeting: Self; expanded by Grip / One protected creature; Braced Grip may protect two

Trigger: Another character declares an attack targeting a creature this Shield’s Grip can protect; use before the attack is rolled.

Effect: Choose a Defense contested by the triggering attack: Fortitude uses Vigor, Composure uses Resolve, or Harmony uses Anima. Increase that Defense by 1 for the protected creature against the triggering attack. Apply this Shield’s compatible properties. Roll only to generate Surges; the base increase is automatic.

Surge 1: Increase the same Defense by an additional 1 against the triggering attack. Once per use.

Design note: Uses one Reaction against that Action. The dice cap uses the selected Attribute under D1.
system.flavor: Turning a failed close attack into separation.
